title: DECISION: Message sorting by receivedAt before display
description:
What: load_messages_for_chat() fetches message IDs from Message/query, then Message/get, then sorts entries by receivedAt (ISO8601 string) in ascending order before converting to display strings.

Why it's good: JMAP does not guarantee query result order when multiple messages exist. Sorting by receivedAt ensures oldest messages appear first in the UI, which is the expected chronological order for a chat. The string comparison works because ISO8601 is sortable (YYYY-MM-DD...). Decouples the sort order from the query result and makes the behavior explicit.
